title: Conductor control for a one-dimensional semilocal domain
statement: Let B be a semilocal (having finitely many maximal ideals) Noetherian domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], let K be its fraction field, and let B' be the integral closure [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] of B in K. Then B' is a semilocal Dedekind domain (a Noetherian domain of Krull dimension 1 that is integrally closed in its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]) with fraction field K. If x is a nonzero element of the Jacobson radical (the intersection of all maximal ideals) of B', then for every y in B' there exists an integer n>0 such that x^n y belongs to B.

proof.text: By [lem-sc-semilocal-dim-one-normalization], the integral closure B' is a semilocal Dedekind domain and has fraction field K.

Fix x in the Jacobson radical of B' and y in B'. Let A be the subring of B' generated over B by x and y. Both generators are integral over B, so A is finite over B by [lem-sc-finite-generated-integral-subring]. Since B has Krull dimension 1 and A and B have the same fraction field K, [lem-sc-finite-integral-conductor] gives n>0 with m_B^n A contained in B, where m_B is the Jacobson radical of B.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09N2 proof, paragraph beginning Given x, y in B'

proof.text: Because B' is integral over A and the inclusion $A \to B'$ is injective, the map $\operatorname{Spec}(B') \to \operatorname{Spec}(A)$ is surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-injective-lying-over]. By [lem-sc-integral-overring-jacobson-power], A is semilocal and x, which lies in A and in the Jacobson radical of B', lies in the radical of m_B A; hence x^m belongs to m_B A for some m>0. Therefore x^{nm}y belongs to m_B^n A and hence to B.

lean.statement: theorem semilocal_dim_one_conductor (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsNoetherianRing B] [Finite (MaximalSpectrum B)] (hdim : ringKrullDim B = 1) (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K] : Finite (MaximalSpectrum (integralClosure B K)) ∧ IsDedekindDomain (integralClosure B K) ∧ ringKrullDim (integralClosure B K) = 1 ∧ IsFractionRing (integralClosure B K) K ∧ ∀ x y : integralClosure B K, x ≠ 0 → x ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal (integralClosure B K)) → ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ b : B, algebraMap B K b = (x : K) ^ n * (y : K)
